criteria.statement: assistant.agentic.tool_mode defaults to native and validates only native or prompted.
When prompted mode is selected for an OpenAI-compatible provider, Bahia constructs a prompted AgentModelClient and leaves native/Anthropic behavior unchanged.
Prompted requests send no native tools or tool_choice fields and inject tool schemas plus the strict tool_call fenced JSON protocol into text messages.
Prior assistant tool calls and tool observations render as readable text without using the native tool role.
Prompted text responses return final content; valid tool_call blocks return canonical ToolCalls with StopReason tool_calls; malformed blocks are handled gracefully as text.
Context-window provider failures remain classified as ContextTooLargeError.
